name: Sky View LUT with Angular Compression
aliases: Seb Hillaire’s Sky and Atmosphere Rendering Technique
definition: A technique for rendering sky and atmosphere using a precomputed Look-Up Table (LUT) with angular compression, ported from a reference implementation.
summary: Sky View LUT with Angular Compression is a sky rendering technique using a precomputed lookup table with non-linear angular mappings to optimize sampling density for atmospheric light scattering.
